name: Decrypted Letter
summary: The Decrypted Letter is a cryptic message found among Syndicate thieves in the Alterac foothills. Magistrate Maleb in Southshore sees reason to fear that the thieves answer to another power.

sections.title: A Strange Message
sections.body: The foothills of Alterac hold more than thieves: the Decrypted Letter found in a Syndicate encampment troubles Magistrate Maleb of Southshore. Its words are cryptic, and Maleb recognizes that neither a thief nor an Alterac noble wrote them. He suspects the Syndicate has ties to another power, though the letter leaves him dreading what that might be.

faq.q: Where was the Decrypted Letter found?
faq.answer: The Decrypted Letter was found in a Syndicate encampment in the Alterac foothills.
Magistrate Maleb in Southshore should receive the Decrypted Letter.

faq.q: What does Maleb make of the letter?
faq.answer: Maleb says the letter was written by neither a thief nor an Alterac noble. He suspects the Syndicate has ties to another power.
Maleb says the letter was written by neither a thief nor an Alterac noble; its author remains unknown.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can bring the message from the Alterac foothills to Magistrate Maleb in Southshore, where he can judge the threat.
